item.title: Hiraizumi Fujiwara Festivals: Heian Pageantry — Guide
item.description: Hiraizumi holds two Fujiwara festivals a year — in May and early November — recreating the glory of its 12th-century golden age. Processions in full Heian court costume, sacred kagura and the magnificent Ennen no Mai (longevity dance) performed by masked priests fill the UNESCO temple grounds, drawing visitors from across Japan. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Hiraizumi, Iwate Hours Festival days (May 1–5; early Nov) Admission Grounds free; some events ticketed Time needed 2–3 hours Best time May & early November Highlights Processions in full Heian court costume.
